body:
Real PARENA mod (stdlib/editor/construct_split.prn) hooking into the Ctrl+T Spotlight overlay. Typing /construct-split N while a real *_CONSTRUCT.txt bundle is the active buffer splits it across file boundaries into N roughly-equal panes via spawn_new_instance, mirroring the existing SKFile mod/C-driver split. New dedicated test (tests/test_construct_split.c, 13/13 pass) + extended test_editor_spotlight.c. Zero regressions: 336-test suite + test-editor-spotlight + test-construct-split + full editor-demo rebuild + Xvfb smoke + bazel build/test all clean. PARENA commit 8b7334a.

⚓ ☃
title: construct-split Spotlight mod: real PARENA plugin, /construct-split N
